messages.body: Good afternoon madam. This is Inspector Sharma from the Mumbai Cyber Crime department. Please confirm you are Mrs Kamla Devi.
Beta, I don't understand these things. Which office are you calling from?
Your Aadhaar is linked to a money laundering case. A warrant is ready and you will be arrested within two hours.
Please don't do anything to me beta, I am alone at home. Tell me slowly, how do I fix it?
Madam, case band karwane ke liye verification amount Rs 49,999 abhi inspector.verify22@okaxis par transfer kijiye. Yeh refundable hai, jaanch ke baad wapas mil jayega.
inspector.verify22@okaxis... haan ji, I typed it but it is showing failed. Is there any other account?
That id is under maintenance. Use this one instead, narcotics.clear07@okicici, and send the amount right now.
Beta, my grandson Rohan is coming now, he will help me. I will call you back.

report.summary: Reported digital arrest scam. The caller went through authority claim, threat, payment ask and asked for money to 2 collection id(s): na****@okicici (upi), in****@okaxis (upi). 0 payment(s) to these ids were held by the bank's guard (INTEL_MATCH).
